(def equiv-sequential
  "Assumes x is sequential. Returns true if x equals y, otherwise
  returns false."
  (fn [x y]
  (boolean
    (when (sequential? y)
      (if (and (counted? x) (counted? y)
               (not (== (count x) (count y))))
        false
        (loop [xs (seq x) ys (seq y)]
          (cond (nil? xs) (nil? ys)
            (nil? ys) false
            (= (first xs) (first ys)) (recur (next xs) (next ys))
            :else false)))))))
